headline: Aer Lingus reports profit slump, plans capacity and job cuts
summary: Aer Lingus posted a profit drop of €28 million and announced plans for capacity and job reductions, with its CEO expecting an ongoing 500-role cut program to finish by year-end.
why: Aer Lingus is a prominent Irish flag-carrier airline operating international and regional passenger routes.

impacts.name: Aer Lingus
impacts.why: Profits slumped by €28 million, forcing the airline to initiate capacity and job cuts.
